origin.description: Update the value of a progress bar created by startpb.

arguments.name: pb
arguments.text: A progress bar object created by startpb.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: New value for the progress bar.

origin.details: Uses getOption("pboptions")$type to choose utils::setTxtProgressBar, tcltk::setTkProgressBar, or utils::setWinProgressBar on Windows. When type is shiny and a Shiny app is running, calls pb$set with title and label from pboptions. Returns NULL when dopb() is FALSE (type none or NULL).
origin.value: Length-one numeric giving the previous value, invisibly. NULL when the progress bar is turned off in pboptions.
origin.example:
opb <- pboptions(type="txt", style=1, char=">")
pb <- startpb(0, 10)
setpb(pb, 5)
getpb(pb)
closepb(pb)
pboptions(opb)

translation.description: Set the progress value when pboptions allow a progress bar.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: New numeric value for the bar.

translation.details: Reads the module pboptions dict and mirrors dopb, doshiny, and bar-type dispatch. Timer, txt, tk, and win bars use the internal stand-in up after reading get_val. Returns None when type is none.
translation.value: Previous numeric value, or None when progress is off in pboptions.
translation.example:
from pbapply.setpb import setpb
from pbapply.startpb import closepb, getpb, replace_pboptions, reset_pboptions, startpb

former = replace_pboptions(type="txt", style=1, char=">")
pb = startpb(0, 10)
setpb(pb, 5)
print(getpb(pb))
closepb(pb)
reset_pboptions(former)
